title: Use familiar minimum-to-maximum slider directions

statement.en: Use familiar minimum-to-maximum directions for sliders.
statement.ja: sliderには見慣れたminimumからmaximumへの方向を使う。

conditions: For horizontal sliders, place the minimum on the leading side and maximum on the trailing side.
For vertical sliders, place the minimum at the bottom and maximum at the top.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Sliders experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるSlidersの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

conditions: This can help when the slider represents a wide value range.
A text field can show the exact value and accept a specific value.
